summary: Add append-only privacy-safe decision records as non-authoritative audit evidence.

candidates.rationale: Add the universal privacy and append-only decision-rationale invariant.
Define the machine-readable decision-record contract without third-party schema dependencies.
Add standard-library validation and append-only decision-record writing.
Add adversarial privacy, supersession, path, and append-only tests.
Integrate decision audit evidence into the existing archive route and workspace indexes without creating new authority.

applied_changes.description: Added Convention 29 for privacy-safe append-only decision evidence.
Added standard-library decision-record validator and append-only writer.
Integrated decision records into archive routing, indexes, workspace metadata, and impact policy.
